designationHistory.name: Huron Islands Reservation
designationHistory.indexText: Established Oct. 10, 1905, as the Huron Islands Reservation by executive order of President Theodore Roosevelt, as a refuge and breeding ground for birds such as the herring gull.

sources.name: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service: Huron National Wildlife Refuge, About Us
American Presidency Project: Executive Order 7795, Jan. 21, 1938 (revokes "the Executive Order of October 10, 1905, establishing the Huron Islands Reservation")
FWS ServCat: Seney NWR and satellites I&M plan: Huron NWR established by Executive Order dated Oct. 10, 1905

review.note: Year confirmed; full date, name and T.R. signature from EO 7795, which re-established it as the Huron Migratory Bird Refuge in 1938.

designationHistory.indexOriginal: The refuge was established in 1905 as a refuge and breeding ground for migratory birds and other wildlife, especially the herring gull, which had large nesting colonies on the islands.
